segments.sensitive: Several reviewers with sensitive skin report the product is surprisingly well tolerated with no breakouts or irritation, though a few note it must be used every other night or sparingly, and one warns it may be too strong for drier/more sensitive skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers who describe their skin as dry or on the drier side report the treatment works but increases dryness and flaking, sometimes requiring reduced frequency or extra moisturizer.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin and occasional dry patches reports it controlled breakouts without drying the face completely.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her 40s reports it is the only treatment that worked for acne that appeared unexpectedly at that age.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers report individual pimples or spots shrinking, flattening, or disappearing within 1-3 days, especially with overnight use; a minority (e.g. reviews 0, 2, 5) say it did little to reduce spots and mainly dried the skin.
concerns.blemishes: Many describe fewer, smaller, and less noticeable blemishes with continued use, including cystic and hormonal breakouts; a few (reviews 1, 3, 4) report no visible improvement or worsening of a blemish.
concerns.redness: Numerous reviewers note reduced redness and inflammation around treated spots within a day or two; one reviewer (3) reports redness stayed the same or slightly worsened.
concerns.barrier: Dryness and occasional flaking or peeling around the treated area are commonly reported, generally managed by moisturizing after application; a couple of reviewers found the drying effect excessive relative to results.
concerns.oiliness: Not enough reviews specifically address oil control to draw a conclusion.

aspects.libelle: Bulky outer packaging for product size

extraits.texte: I was incentivized by Influenster and Differin with this complimentary product in exchange for my honest review. I've tried this cream for several days now and I don't see any impact on the reduction of my pimples or redness on my face. In fact, I feel like it has made it slightly worse. It has dried out my skin around the blemish, but the blemish itself is still inflamed and contains pus. I've tried leaving it on overnight as well as using it during the day… neither seems to have any benefit. I also have to say that I'm not appreciating the oversized packaging. This small tube is the size of a hydrocortisone tube but it's in a box 2 or 3 times the area you need to fit it. It seems like such a waste of paper resources.

in my experience, benzoyl peroxide is the best spot treatment and is the only type that has worked for me. my skin also tends to need a stronger formula so this is wonderful. it didn't work for me when pimples and such already had heads (makes sense) but otherwise worked great when i notice nastiness start to form. i will say if you have drier or more sensitive skin, this may be too extreme for your skin (maybe try one with less percentage of benzoyl peroxide). overall great product

Listen, I don't mean to sound dramatic, but wow, this stuff is MAGIC! I struggle with those stubborn under the skin pimples that, no matter what, just won't leave me alone. Even the pimples that come to the surface that just linger around and do not go away! I started using this and, no joke, I've noticed pimples that flatten in the matter of a day, which is insane. I had one on my cheek, and it was so annoying and big and noticeable. I used this one night and when I woke up the next day, it was flat, the pimple was still there, but it wasn't as big and prominent. If you do use this, I would suggest first using it once a day, and then slowly getting into twice a day if necessary. My skin is a bit more in the drier side as it is getting colder and I have had to use this a bit less as it does dry out my skin a bit more. But even when I use it less, it is still just as effective. I would recommend this if you have acne, it is the perfect way to get rid of those pesky pimples.

However the pump is tricky. Invariably if you try to just pump a fresh bottle, one side won't come out. You need to cover the holes with a finger and then give several small pumps. This will prime the pump and always resolves the issue for me, although on occasion I've had to repeat the process. Then before each use, tap the top of the bottle (with cap on!) against your palm a few times. I really wish they would somehow just fix this, as everyone seems to have the same issue and it's been going on for years. But the product is well worth the cost and hassle of getting the pump going. Note, if you have sensitive skin like mine, you may not be able to use it every night. I use it every other night and my skin is able to tolerate it pretty well.

I was rather surprised after using this fragrance free 10% benzoyl peroxide product a couple of times. I have purchased and tried many benzoyl peroxide spot treatments before, however, they always leave a red and sensitive mark wherever I put it. This one was different, there was no redness or dryness after using it continuously. Of course, after the 4th time in a row you will start seeing sensitivity and dryness but that's normal for 10% concentration. A very good value for your money, definitely recommend

I used this acne spot treatment for the last few weeks and I saw a huge difference in my face. I usually break out and my skin is normal with some dry spots and this did not dry my face completely. I was able to just use it as directed. I did use a moisturizer as well after applying this product. Does not have a scent which was a plus. Does leave a white patch after the product dries but it did not affect me whatsoever. Over all recommend this product!

This works amazing!! I could see a difference within the next day or so. I think this is very worth it. I have very sensitive skin and this didn't break me out in the slightest. The scent didn't bother me and I'm sensitive to scents.
